title: Dreamoon and Sums
statementMd:
Dreamoon loves summing up something for no reason. One day he obtains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ occasionally. He wants to calculate the sum of all *nice* integers. Positive integer $*x*$ is called *nice* if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/747b668d05dce59a14c79f7573cf84d4af25536c.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f2c3c9a716cef71591af317f816d0d89605de8cd.png), where $*k*$ is some **integer** number in range $[1, *a*]$.

By ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e6fb3a33a9e71aae77ea40b847b4751cad6a9b2.png) we denote the *quotient* of integer division of $*x*$ and $*y*$. By ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13ccd3404ca33681bef79230f269517728677a3a.png) we denote the *remainder* of integer division of $*x*$ and $*y*$. You can read more about these operations here: `http://goo.gl/AcsXhT`.

The answer may be large, so please print its remainder modulo $1 000 000 007$ ($10^{9} + 7$). Can you compute it faster than Dreamoon?

## Input

The single line of the input contains two integers $*a*$, $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{7}$).

## Output

Print a single integer representing the answer modulo $1 000 000 007$ ($10^{9} + 7$).

## Note

For the first sample, there are no nice integers because ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03b1dc6bae5180f8a2d8eb85789e8b393e585970.png) is always zero.

For the second sample, the set of nice integers is ${3, 5}$.
statementZhMd:
Dreamoon 喜欢毫无理由地进行一些求和。一天，他偶然得到两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$。他想计算所有*优美*整数的总和。如果对于某个取值范围在 $[1, *a*]$ 内的**整数** $*k*$，满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/747b668d05dce59a14c79f7573cf84d4af25536c.png) 且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f2c3c9a716cef71591af317f816d0d89605de8cd.png)，则称正整数 $*x*$ 是*优美*的。

我们用 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1e6fb3a33a9e71aae77ea40b847b4751cad6a9b2.png) 表示 $*x*$ 除以 $*y*$ 的整数除法的*商*，用 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13ccd3404ca33681bef79230f269517728677a3a.png) 表示 $*x*$ 除以 $*y*$ 的整数除法的*余数*。你可以在这里阅读有关这些运算的更多信息：`http://goo.gl/AcsXhT`。

答案可能很大，请输出其对 $1 000 000 007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模后的结果。你能比 Dreamoon 更快地计算出答案吗？

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{7}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示答案对 $1 000 000 007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模后的结果。

## 说明

对于第一个样例，不存在优美整数，因为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03b1dc6bae5180f8a2d8eb85789e8b393e585970.png) 总是为零。

对于第二个样例，优美整数的集合为 ${3, 5}$。
